GroupTrack V2.5 Manual
Map-anchored · launch-point shell · 2026-06-23 · detail fills in per walk-through
How this manual is organized. Two maps, each shown with its launch points labeled. Tap a control on the image, find its letter below, and that section walks you through it. Each launch point is being detailed with real screens during the walk-through. V2.5 only.

Convoy Map

Convoy Map launch points (A–Q) plus gestures. The GroupTrack icon (A) is the last icon in the Meshtastic left sidebar.
A — GroupTrack / Radio Setup
The GroupTrack icon in the Meshtastic left sidebar (last icon). Opens the GroupTrack menu for radio setup — the prerequisite to using the app with radios.
▸ To be detailed & decomposed during the walk-through (screens drop in here).

Records the ride track.
▸ To be detailed & decomposed during the walk-through (screens drop in here).
